output.title: Is there a fee to file an appeal?
output.draft_text:
Question: Is there a fee to file an appeal?

Answer: [Yes/No], there [is/is not] a fee to file an appeal of a [denied claim/coverage decision/prior authorization decision] under [plan name or plan type].

[If no fee:] You will not be charged to file a [first-level/internal] appeal. [Confirm whether this also applies to second-level and external review requests.]

[If a fee applies:] The fee is [fee amount] for [appeal level or type]. It is paid by [payment method] to [payee]. [The fee can/cannot be waived if [waiver criteria]]. [The fee is/is not refunded if the appeal is decided in your favor.]

To file an appeal, submit your request by [submission method, e.g., mail, fax, portal, phone] to [appeals address or contact]. Appeals must be filed within [number of days] days of [triggering event, e.g., the date on the denial notice].

If you have questions about filing an appeal, contact [contact name or department] at [phone number] during [hours of operation].
placeholders: [submission method, e.g., mail, fax, portal, phone]
[triggering event, e.g., the date on the denial notice]
author_checklist: Confirm whether any fee applies to filing an appeal, and keep only the matching 'no fee' or 'fee applies' wording.
Confirm whether the answer differs by appeal level (internal, second-level, external review) and by plan or product type.
If a fee applies, confirm the amount, payment method, payee, waiver criteria, and refund policy.
Confirm which decision types this answer covers (claim denials, coverage decisions, prior authorization, pharmacy decisions).
Confirm the appeal submission methods and address or contact.
Confirm the filing deadline and the event that starts it.
Confirm the member contact number and hours for appeal questions.
Check for state- or plan-specific rules on appeal fees, and decide whether this unit belongs in benefits, pharmacy, or shared-legal.
Remove all bracketed placeholders and unused options before approval.
